R2-01.why: Theme demand is validated: 'Clean the House!' (Snowy Interactive, Jul 2026, chapter 3, ~5-8K peak CCU, 0.9-4.4M visits per conflicting trackers) uses the same 'clean before Mom gets home' premise but is a PvE chore game. A 1vN party->panic->hunt structure with a player-controlled Parent was not found on Roblox (searches turned up only itch.io jam games like Party Foul and Panic! at the House Party). The USP fits in one sentence and the thumbnail sells itself. Weaknesses: it sits next to Granny, Flee the Facility, Hide the Body and prop hunt, and the hotspot + evidence-state system is a modest moat. A kit-built clone could copy the theme within weeks of any traction.
R2-01.fix: Make the Report Card and the snitch mechanic the brand, since they are the hard-to-clone social signature. Ship 2+ houses and weekly House Rules at launch so a clone can't match the content cadence, and put the player-Parent in the title/thumbnail to separate it from Clean the House's PvE.
R2-01.competitors: Clean the House! (Snowy Interactive, ~8K peak); Hide the Body; Granny-likes; Flee the Facility; prop-hunt games; Don't Burn the House Down! (single-player)

R2-02.why: A direct Roblox analogue exists. 'Boat Together [1 - 6 Player]' (PanCommunity, Dec 2025) has 8.2M visits but only a ~2K all-time peak and ~155 live, so the niche is proven but small and weakly held. Steam has Boat Together (Beaked, Nov 2025), Super Raft Boat Together and the hippo-raft game, and Fart Together's Roblox copy shows the 'one vehicle, many thrusters' fad is current but crude. The differentiators are per-seat contextual verbs, rotating absurd vehicles and Captain-rule cosmetics. They are real but easy to copy, and the core is a known shape. Backseat Rally (28-55K peak) owns 'role-split vehicle co-op' mindshare right now.
R2-02.fix: Lean into the vehicle roster as the identity (bathtub, shopping-cart rocket, sky-balloon) and the 'WHO SANK US?' blame card. Ship versus Raft Race at launch, which Boat Together lacks, and position it against Backseat Rally as 'everyone drives' rather than 'one drives'.
R2-02.competitors: Boat Together [1-6 Player] (Roblox, 8.2M visits, ~2K peak); Boat Ride Together; Backseat Rally; Fart Together copies (taken down); Steam: Boat Together, Super Raft Boat Together

R2-03.why: No Roblox game was found with museum statues that freeze when the guard's light hits them (closest: Sprunki Museum night-guard horror and Weeping-Angel tutorials). The combination of beam-only tagging, a battery limit, a shared mischief meter and skins that spawn matching NPC decoys is a genuinely fresh mix, and the decoy-skin monetization is clever and defensible. But it lives in a crowded adjacent lane (Be NPC or Die, DISGUISE, In Plain Sight, Prank the Teacher, many Red-Light-Green-Light games), so at thumbnail level it can read as 'another NPC-blend game'. The rule set is simple enough for a clone to copy.
R2-03.fix: Make 'flashlight = only way to tag' plus the pranks visible in every thumbnail and clip (moustached T-rex, knight helmet). Use the 'Caught on Camera' reel as a shareable hook, and lock in a distinct art identity (living-exhibit cast) so it isn't mistaken for a Be NPC or Die clone.
R2-03.competitors: Be NPC or Die; DISGUISE; In Plain Sight; Prank the Teacher; Red Light Green Light/Squid Game clones; Sprunki Museum (night guard horror)

R2-04.why: Draw-to-cast exists on Roblox: 'Draw Spells Magic Arena' (Re-Bloxian Wizard, 0.4-1.5M visits, ~615 CCU) is PvP and live with codes as of Nov 2026, so 'draw spells' is not new as a hook. The co-op wave defence with 1-second two-player fusion, a misfire table and zero-movement full-screen drawing is distinct from it and natively mobile-first, which is rare on Roblox. However, the wrapper (wave/tower defence) is one of Roblox's most saturated genres, and gesture recognition is copyable. The fusion discovery log is the most defensible element.
R2-04.fix: Lead marketing with co-op fusion ('draw together = firenado'), not 'draw spells', to separate it from Draw Spells Magic Arena. Make the Rune Book of 30 fusions and the funny misfires the identity, and avoid tower-defence visual tropes in the thumbnail.
R2-04.competitors: Draw Spells Magic Arena (Roblox PvP draw-to-cast); Roblox tower-defence giants (TDS, Anime/Units-style TDs); Magicka (inspiration); YAPYAP

R2-05.why: No Roblox game was found that combines counterfeit inspection with a hidden-forger social deduction. Existing deduction games are word-based ('Who's the Fake?', 'Faker') or Among Us clones ('Impostor', 'Imposter'). Shop tycoons are common, but inspection-based ones are not. Timing is good: Probably Stolen launched Oct 28, 2026 with 660K+ demo players, and Papers-Please-style inspection is novel on Roblox. The USP is clear ('one of you is the forger'). But the hybrid needs explanation (tools, tells, catalogue, meetings), deduction on Roblox is dominated by MM2-scale incumbents, and the reveal punchlines and tell systems are content a clone could copy.
R2-05.fix: Lead the thumbnail and first 30 seconds with a single tell-reveal ('UV lamp exposes the fake'). Make the visual punchline reveals and the adaptive NPC forger (PvE) the moat. Ship the PvE 'Open Shop' first so the game isn't dependent on full lobbies, where Among Us clones already win.
R2-05.competitors: Who's the Fake?; Faker; Impostor/Imposter (Among Us clones); MM2; Fake a Masterpiece (tiny); Steam: Probably Stolen, Papers Please

R2-06.why: The concept itself admits this is the most crowded lane on Roblox in late 2026: Sell Fries! (~112K peak), 7 Days Cat-Sitting (+825% in W40), licensed Exit 8 (8-player co-op) and many anomaly clones. The Watcher/Patroller information asymmetry is a real twist, but at the store-tile level it reads as 'another anomaly game', and the anomaly-primitive generator is reproducible. Incumbents already ship chapters, which raises the bar.
R2-06.fix: Rebrand around the asymmetry (e.g., 'one friend has the cameras') with a non-horror or comedic setting to step out of the anomaly-horror cluster. Or make the Watcher a 1v1 'trust me' social mechanic with a deliberately unreliable/lying Watcher role, a new verb incumbents lack.
R2-06.competitors: Sell Fries!; 7 Days Cat-Sitting; Exit 8 (licensed Roblox); I'm on Observation Duty-likes; numerous anomaly games

R2-07.why: I found no established Roblox Content Warning analogue by search (the concept claims several small ones; unverified), and Content Warning's PS5 release (Apr 2026) keeps the format fresh. A real 3D replay theatre of your crew is a meaningful and somewhat defensible technical USP. But ghost-hunting/co-op horror is crowded on Roblox, the concept is thin (one paragraph of core), and 'film spooky stuff' is easy to copy at the surface. Without the replay done well, it is indistinguishable from generic ghost hunts.
R2-07.fix: Make the replay-plus-fake-comments payoff the entire pitch and thumbnail, add creator-facing exports (shareable replay codes) and invest in distinctive ghost 'performers' with scripted comedic events that are costly to clone.
R2-07.competitors: Generic Roblox ghost-hunt games (Blair-style, Specter-style); unverified small Content Warning-likes; Steam: Content Warning

R2-08.why: Fragile co-op carry is well covered: 'Carry the Glass Together! [2 Player Obby]' (Ritronics, ~13K peak Sep 2026, ~36-39M visits, now declining ~39%/30d), Don't Shatter [2 Player Obby], plus many R.E.P.O.-style value-meter clones. Per-parcel handling rules (cake sags, aquarium sloshes, dragon wakes) and versus sabotage are nice additions but read as incremental. The trend also appears to be past its peak.
R2-08.fix: Pick one signature that no carry-obby has. For example, living parcels (baby dragon, octopus) that react and escape, making it a 'herd the delivery' game. Or lead with Versus Couriers sabotage, the theme's most differentiated mode.
R2-08.competitors: Carry the Glass Together! (Roblox); Don't Shatter; R.E.P.O. clones on Roblox (E.R.P.O. etc.); Totally Reliable Delivery Service

R2-09.why: Breeding and visual mutations are commoditized on Roblox: Catch and Tame (breeding, up to 4x mutations, Trait Machine), Grow a Garden pet mutations, Steal an Egg mutations, Build a Zoo mutations. Monster auto-battlers exist too (Blox Monsters, fusion/evolution, Apr 2026), alongside Units Battlegrounds and Merge-tactics-likes. The live 'one tap' ability and gremlin spectator role are small twists. Being a merge of two concepts makes the USP muddled, so it is hard to say in one line why it isn't a pet sim with a battle mode.
R2-09.fix: Pick one hook and say it in one line, e.g. 'your losing critters' kids fight back': make visible inheritance (the family tree changes the attack pattern) the star. Drop or minimize generic pet-sim framing, and lead with the gremlin-after-KO mechanic for clip appeal.
R2-09.competitors: Catch and Tame; Blox Monsters; Units Battlegrounds; Merge a Mini Army; Pet Simulator family; Grow a Garden / Steal an Egg mutation systems

R2-10.why: The concept claims 'none found on Roblox', which is wrong. Monobombo [🙈🙉🙊] (Silent Heart, a 3-player sensory-handicap bomb defusal near-copy of BOMBANANA) had a ~10K peak in Jul 2026, and other Roblox listings tagged 'Bomb Defusal'/'Bombanana' plus several Keep Talking-inspired games exist. Fuse Friends' real differentiator is that it is 100% pictographic, voice-free and 2-player, while Monobombo recommends voice chat. That matters for under-13s and chat-gated players, but the premise is no longer novel and the first mover already holds the search term.
R2-10.fix: Position explicitly as 'no voice needed' and kid-safe: lead with the stamp-relay mechanic in the thumbnail, avoid bomb/monkey visuals (go party cannon/cake), and make the rotating seasonal rulebook and daily solo puzzle the retention moat Monobombo lacks.
R2-10.competitors: Monobombo (Roblox, ~10K peak); other Roblox Bombanana/KTANE-inspired defusal games; Steam: BOMBANANA!, Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes

R2-11.why: A near-identical premise is live: 'Land or Die!' (Roblox, beta) is literally 'handle emergencies, repair systems, work together to land the aircraft'. Another listing ('Handle fires, turbulence & in-flight emergencies') and the long-running Survive a Plane Crash also exist, and Backseat Rally covers role-split vehicle co-op. The vehicle roster (sub, rocket, train) is the only clear addition, and it is easy to copy.
R2-11.fix: Either drop it or pivot hard. For example, make the vehicle itself collectible/buildable (players design the airship layout, which creates the station puzzle), or make it a 1vN sabotage-crew game so it isn't a Land or Die clone.
R2-11.competitors: Land or Die! (Roblox); in-flight emergency plane games; Survive a Plane Crash; Backseat Rally; Steam: IRON NEST, Overcooked

R2-12.why: Roblox firefighting games are roleplay/dispatch sims (Firefighting Sim by Blackbox Express, which includes cat-in-tree animal calls; Oxville Fire Rescue; Fire Rescue Simulator; ER:LC). Animal-rescue tycoons are trending: 'Rescue Animals!' (Scratch Labs, Jul 2026, ~20K peak Sep 2026), Rescue Animals (Devextra, 31.9M visits), My Animal Rescue. I found no game combining round-based procedural co-op firefighting with a collect-the-rescued-critter sanctuary. The USP is clear, wholesome and Kids/Select-friendly, and it rides two proven demand signals. Risks: either half is individually copyable, and a Rescue Animals! dev could bolt on a fire mode. Grid fire spread plus the two-player carries is a moderate moat.
R2-12.fix: Make the deterministic critter-per-building collection and 'special guests' the long-tail moat (seasonal critter drops tied to building types). Show the collapse-plus-rescue moment in every thumbnail, and keep runs round-based and chaotic to stay clearly distinct from the roleplay fire sims.
R2-12.competitors: Firefighting Sim (Blackbox Express); Oxville Fire Rescue; Fire Rescue Simulator; Emergency Response: Liberty County; Rescue Animals! (Scratch Labs, ~20K peak); Rescue Animals (Devextra); My Animal Rescue

overall_notes: 14 web searches; tracker figures (RoWatcher/Rotrends) conflict and are third-party. Key corrections to concept docs: R2-10's 'none found on Roblox' is false (Monobombo, ~10K peak Jul 2026, a direct BOMBANANA-style copy). R2-11 has a near-identical live competitor (Land or Die!). R2-02's Boat Together is confirmed but small (8.2M visits, ~2K peak). Not found on Roblox: a 1vN party-mess hunt (R2-01), a counterfeit-inspection deduction game (R2-05), a museum-statue flashlight game (R2-03), a Content Warning analogue (R2-07) or a co-op fire + animal-collection hybrid (R2-12). Strongest differentiation: R2-01, R2-05, R2-12 (7). Weakest: R2-11 (3), R2-06/R2-08/R2-09 (4). Defensibility against AI-built clones is low across the board. Only content cadence, social signatures (snitch/Report Card, fusion log, critter collections) and brand/thumbnail ownership create durable separation.
